extracted.name: Slow Cooker Creamed Corn (Just Like Rudy's BBQ)
extracted.description: Corn is combined with cream cheese, butter, and cream and simmered in a slow cooker for a great side for your barbeque.
instruction_lines: Stir whipping cream, cream cheese, butter, sugar, salt, and pepper together in a slow cooker set to High; cook, stirring regularly, until the cheese and butter are melted, about 10 minutes.
Stir corn into cream mixture. Cook on Low for 4 hours.
